selling climax 1 Oct (high, downtrend); 7 Oct no supply - low significance in a downtrend with strength in the background; Strength 70
Context now: downtrend (falling 50-day, lower highs and lower lows, -37% in 20 bars); background: selling climax 1 Oct; two tests 17 Jul–11 Aug on volume 44% below average - a low-volume test inside the range (moderate significance); two no-supply bars 20 Jul–22 Jul on volume 73% below average - no selling pressure in the range (moderate significance); effort to fall 31 Aug on 3.9x volume, closed on the low - effort to fall toward the range lows (moderate significance); effort to fall 24 Sep on 2.5x volume, closed on the low - effort to fall in a downtrend: supply in control (moderate significance); selling climax 1 Oct on 2.5x volume, closed in the upper half - climactic selling with strength already appearing: accumulation, at support / new lows (high significance); last 5 bars: down bars on heavier volume (1.4x vs 1.1x) = supply in control; latest: squat bar (high volume, narrow spread) 6 Oct on 1.8x volume, closed off the lows - but heavy volume, no progress after strength: absorption, at support / new lows (low significance); latest: no supply 7 Oct on 0.6x volume, closed on the low - no selling pressure after climactic strength: background has changed (low significance: marginal bar) (awaiting next bar); balance strength 70/100.

rs.src: RS line = GLAS close ÷ SPY Massive (formerly Polygon.io) grouped-daily adjusted bars, RS cache feeds/rs/cache/grouped close on the same date (same data source as the chart bars; dates without a SPY close are skipped, never interpolated); shown in the bar tooltip. Blue dot under a price bar = RS line above its prior 251 bars (52-week RS-line high) while the close is NOT at a 252-bar closing high (RS leads price); RS-line highs together with price are listed in the tooltip only. Only 70 bars of RS history (< 252): no new-high dots, high is vs available history only.

rating.label: IBD-style RS (our calc, not IBD's official rating)
rating.src: feeds/rs/latest.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py: raw = 2·ROC63 + ROC126 + ROC189 + ROC252, percentile 1-99; rank 1 = strongest)

hist.rule: STRONG (bright green): rating >= 70 and d >= +3 · FIRM (dark green): rating >= 70 and -3 < d < +3 · WEAK (dark red): rating < 50 or d <= -10 · NEUTRAL (olive): everything else (rating 50-69, or 3-10 below its MA). A band switches only after the new state holds 2 sessions in a row; no band before the MA21 exists.
hist.src: RS rating history: feeds/rs/rating_history.json (research-tools/rs_rank.py; each session ranked from the Massive grouped-daily cache using only bars up to that session; only sessions with a full 252-session lookback). History for GLAS starts 2025-10-07 and ends 2026-10-07; nothing is drawn before it. Orange line = 21-session simple moving average of the rating (needs 21 consecutive rated sessions).
